exposure: singleton full-term small for gestational age (SGA) infant status
cohort: The study included 210 singleton full-term small for gestational age (SGA) infants (90 boys and 120 girls).
finding: Full-term SGA infants show rapid catch-up growth in weight, length, and head circumference in the first year, with the fastest growth observed from birth to 3 months, although the catch-up speed of weight and body length were not balanced.
